title: stage
comment: One stage: everything one published version of Godspeed Mission Control is made of, so that an installer reads its pins from one file instead of carrying its own copy. Both readers, tools/stage.mjs and tools/stage.sh, check a stage file against the rules written here; tools/stage.mjs reads this file itself, tools/stage.sh carries the same rules, because an installer runs before Node is installed. A stage file must be written the way JSON.stringify(stage, null, 2) writes it: two spaces a level, one field a line, no tabs, no backslash escapes, Unix line endings. tools/stage.sh refuses anything else rather than guess. It must also name each field once: JSON allows the same field twice and the two readers would keep a different one of them, so both refuse a file that does. A title holding {} is filled in with the name of the edition or add-on the message is about.

stageFormat.title: stage format
stageFormat.comment: The number of this file format. A reader that does not know the number refuses the file instead of reading it wrongly.

version.title: version
version.comment: The version a stranger installs from this stage.

productCommit.title: product commit
productCommit.comment: The one commit of this repository the version runs: the runtime, the starter folder and the notebook hook all come from it.

kitBootstrap.title: kit bootstrap
kitBootstrap.comment: The two commits of MichaelZelbel/kit-bootstrap this version was installed and built with.

unixEngineCommit.title: shared Unix engine commit
unixEngineCommit.comment: What install-godspeed.sh fetches setup-godspeed.sh from and passes as KB_BRANCH.

windowsBootstrapCommit.title: Windows bootstrap commit
windowsBootstrapCommit.comment: What the Windows setup was built with.

serverEditions.title: server editions
serverEditions.description: an object naming at least one edition
serverEditions.comment: The server image of each edition, by digest, keyed by the edition's name. Today there is one edition, server: the image every server compose file selects.

image.title: server image of the {} edition
image.comment: image@sha256:<64 hex>. A tag is not a pin: it can be moved after a stranger read it.

windowsSetup.title: Windows setup
windowsSetup.comment: The published Windows installer of this version.

addons.title: add-ons
addons.comment: The pinned commit of every carried add-on, by name, as third-party/addons/sources.json held them at the product commit.

previous.title: previous stage
previous.description: null, or the stage this one replaced
previous.comment: null in the first stage entry. Later entries name the version they replaced and the commit of the stage file it came from.

withdrawn.title: withdrawn list
withdrawn.comment: The versions that were taken back. An installer goes on only when the withdrawn answer is exactly no.
